### Goal
Fix Stripe webhook signature verification failures causing customer 400s. Pagination work is paused.

### Constraints and rules
Use `ci-runner-arm64` for integration jobs; `ci-runner-small` hangs. Keep commits small. Sandbox credentials must use the `ledgerly_sbx` prefix in `settings/vendor_sbx.toml`, not environment variables. Post rendered release notes with `ledgerly-release-notes-v3` to `#ledgerly-releases` before staging smoke tests. Paste exact test output.

### Key decisions and facts
Webhook investigation should focus on `ledgerly/webhooks/stripe.py`. Baseline suite: `148 passed, 2 skipped`; six deprecation warnings. SQLAlchemy modernization started in `ledgerly/models.py` by replacing function-based `declarative_base()` with `DeclarativeBase`.

### Ruled out
Invoice pagination is deferred. Legacy session factories remain in `ledgerly/db.py`, `ledgerly/repositories.py`, and `tests/conftest.py`.

### Progress
PDF renderer now includes negative credit lines, uses shared `format_money()`, and calculates pagination via `_row_height()`. Tests: `14 passed, 1 skipped`; billing suite: `83 passed, 4 skipped`. Golden fixtures remain byte-stable. Full baseline passed before the model change.

### Next steps
Reproduce and diagnose Stripe signature failures, patch verification, add regression tests, and run focused/full tests. Re-run tests after the `DeclarativeBase` edit. Then resume visual PDF validation and review/commit the current four-file diff.

### Goal
Add pagination to `GET /v1/invoices`; separately run the ordered avatar CDN migration procedure and investigate slow invoice summaries.

### Constraints and rules
Post rendered release notes in `#ledgerly-releases` using `ledgerly-release-notes-v3` before staging smoke tests. Keep commits small. Execute avatar migration steps sequentially.

### Key decisions and facts
Response envelope: `items`, `total`, `limit`, `offset`; defaults `limit=20`, bounds `1–100`, offset `>=0`. Service count and paginated query share one session. Report code has an N+1 query pattern; invoice/customer covering index was rejected due doubled ingest latency.

### Ruled out
Covering index on invoices `(customer_id, created_at)`.

### Progress
Invoice route/service/schema updated. Existing and pagination tests pass; billing suite: 18 passed. Ruff and `git diff --check` pass. Four relevant files modified. Avatar procedure step 1 succeeded: production DB ready, 18,432 avatar files.

### Next steps
Commit invoice changes separately; render/post release notes before staging smoke test. Resume avatar procedure at step 2, one step at a time. Optimize report queries separately.

### Goal
Add invoice-list pagination; complete the ordered avatar CDN migration; optimize invoice summaries and investigate PDF rendering.

### Constraints and rules
Post rendered release notes to `#ledgerly-releases` using `ledgerly-release-notes-v3` before staging smoke tests. Keep commits small. Run avatar migration steps sequentially. Any sandbox third-party credentials must use the `ledgerly_sbx` prefix and be configured in `settings/vendor_sbx.toml`, not environment variables. Paste exact test output.

### Key decisions and facts
Pagination uses `items`, `total`, `limit`, `offset`; defaults limit 20 (1–100), offset ≥0, with shared session/query count. Invoice summary was refactored to one aggregate query per account and batched minor-unit conversion. Tenant 73 now takes ~4.27s and 37 queries instead of 38.6s and 2,417 queries, with unchanged 14,802 aggregates. Avatar sync completed: 18,432 files.

### Ruled out
Invoice/customer covering index due doubled ingest latency.

### Progress
Invoice tests: 18 passed; reports: 63 passed, 2 PostgreSQL skips. Ruff and whitespace checks pass. Avatar steps 1–5 succeeded, including manifest, migration-run insert, sync, and S3 HEAD. PDF baseline: 12 passed, 1 skipped. `render_invoice()` uses `_format_lines()` on a two-page canvas; seven call sites and three fixtures found.

### Next steps
Commit invoice and report changes separately. Render/post release notes, then staging smoke tests. Continue avatar procedure sequentially. Complete PDF renderer investigation.
